_about: Scientific data library, domain chemistry: the universal columns of the game's body/data/chemistry.json tables, written by scripts/split_data.py. Same columns/rows schema as the game's tables. `id` is stable (see README); `source` holds source keys from sources.json ('; ' separated) or 'open'. Mark is the review state of these columns. A null in a column the engine's data/*.json holds by the same id means the engine file is the home of that value.

substances.title: The initial database (small; the schema is general)

reactions.title: The first reactions (combustion, fermentation, rot; and a set that shows the engine does not care what year it is)
reactions.source: Stoichiometry is exact; rates and conditions are placeholders. Black powder: 75% KNO3, 15% charcoal, 10% sulphur by mass; about 43% of products are gas (CO2, N2, CO, H2S, H2, CH4), 56% solids (potassium salts), about 330 cm3 of gas per gram; the products do not follow one simple equation (CHM-BP). Thermodynamic possibility is not kinetics: a reaction needs its conditions (ChatGPT's point, kept).

domains.title: The domains the engine must eventually cover (architecture now, records later)
domains.source: ChatGPT's list (outside AI), adopted by Rex (2026-10-29): chemistry itself, regardless of whether the civilisation in the game understands it. The record types each domain needs are the keeper's; coverage grows by adding records, never by changing the schema.

reaction_fields.title: The reaction record (every reaction, period or not, is one record of this shape)
reaction_fields.source: Thermodynamic possibility and kinetics kept apart (ChatGPT, kept); conditions as the roles an apparatus must supply (SCIENTIFIC_EQUIPMENT); 'unknown' as the engine's honest answer for a reaction it has no record of.
rows: possibility: free-energy sign at conditions, or 'spontaneous above T'
whether it can happen at all
conditions: temperature range, pressure, atmosphere, catalyst, solvent, contact time
the assembly pipeline (SCIENTIFIC_EQUIPMENT 3): the roles an apparatus must supply
rate: a rate law and an activation energy, or a half-time at a reference temperature
how long; whether the fuel lasts
reaction ids; what happens off-conditions (too hot: charring; too little air: CO)
the engine's answer when conditions are missed
identification: what a period test shows, what an instrument shows
history: first performed, by whom, where; disputes
the engine's honesty flag: a reaction not in the database is unknown, never impossible
DISCOVERY's answer to an attempt the database does not hold
